personText: It's ugly, and the dog may track the mud into our house.

personText: The plants provide environmental and visual variety.
dogText: The terrace gardens reduce the area in which the dog can pee and poop, but they provide shelter for rabbits that the dog likes to see. (He's pretty much given up chasing rabbits; they always run away and hide.)
walkText: The gardens provide variety; there are other areas with grass.

personText: I like songbirds and don't like to see them killed.
dogText: The dog  likes to eat road kill, but I worry that it might make him sick.
walkText: The dead bird lures the dog into the street, where he, too, could get hit by a car.
